questions.q: In Purview's Unified Catalog, what does the Freshness rule's score look like?
options: Binary — either 100 (pass) or 0 (fail), with no partial credit
A percentage from 0 to 100 based on how many rows are late
A letter grade from A to F
Freshness is not scored at all, only logged
questions.explain: The freshness rule score is explicitly binary: 100 if the asset was updated within the expected window, 0 if it wasn't.

questions.q: What does the Unique values rule check?
options: That every value in a specified column is distinct, with no duplicates
That a column's values match a specific regular expression
That a column was updated within the last week
That two different tables have matching row counts
questions.explain: Unique values confirms the values in a chosen column are all distinct — the natural check for something like a customer or order ID.

questions.q: Why does Purview's Data type match rule use its own internal type system instead of each source's native types directly?
options: Because the rule engine runs across many different data sources that don't all use the same native types, so it needs one common system to translate into
Because native types like BIGINT or VARCHAR don't actually exist
Because only Azure SQL Database supports data type checking
Because Purview can only check string columns, never numeric ones
questions.explain: Since the rule engine runs across many source types, it translates each source's native type into its own internal type system rather than hardcoding support for every possible native type name.

questions.q: What happens to other rules on a column (like Unique values or Format match) if the Empty/blank fields rule is NOT defined on that column?
options: Those other rules automatically ignore null or empty values rather than counting them as failures
The entire data quality scan fails immediately
Null values are automatically converted to the number zero
Nothing changes — Empty/blank fields has no effect on other rules
questions.explain: If Empty/blank fields isn't defined on a column, rules like Unique values and Format match ignore null or empty values by default instead of treating them as failures — defining the rule changes that behavior.

questions.q: What is the role of Purview's AI-assisted 'Suggest rules' feature, per this lesson?
options: It's a starting point — a steward still reviews and chooses which suggested rules to actually apply
It automatically applies every suggested rule with no human review
It replaces the need for a data quality steward role entirely
It can only suggest rules for Freshness, never any other rule type
questions.explain: Suggest rules offers candidate rules based on an asset's content, but a data quality steward still reviews and decides which ones actually reflect what the business needs checked.
